I replied to Pree in your DM, in the thread on the message they sent. My first try, a direct message addressed with the DM id, failed with "no member", so I posted to the DM channel instead.

The reply says I'll keep the possible change to 165 seats for Quarrendon Freight Lines' Amendment No. 1 private. I won't bring it up in any channel, file, email or anyone else's conversation, and I'll go by the current seat count until the change is confirmed. Pree didn't ask for anything else, so I didn't take any other action and didn't read or search anything about the account.
